svg.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: absentia architecture: seven modules, one process
svg.desc: cli.py resolves arguments and exit codes; ingest.py owns parse boundaries, pages and chunks; variants.py owns the deterministic rewrite dictionary; scan.py owns the FTS5 schema, sentence vectors and max combination; attest.py owns the decision table, core_sha256 and verify; render.py writes a ledger that copies values; mcp_server.py speaks stdio JSON-RPC without an SDK. Artifacts are manifest.json, index.sqlite, attestation.json, ledger.md and two MCP tools. There is no torch, no hosted API and one network egress: the local endpoint the operator names.
